gloss: to replace (by buying a new one)

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {買|か}い{替|か}えませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {買|か}い{替|か}えていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {買|か}い{替|か}えていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to replace (by buying a new one), to buy a replacement
definitions.explanation: To purchase something new to replace an old or broken item. Implies discarding the old and obtaining a new version.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{買|か}い{替|か}えた。
examples.english: I replaced my smartphone with a new one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{買|か}い{替|か}える。
examples.english: To replace an old refrigerator with a new one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{壊|こわ}れた→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{買|か}い{替|か}える⟦しかない→〜しかない：30533_shikanai⟧。
examples.english: It broke, so I have no choice but to buy a replacement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{買|か}い{替|か}える⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦{迷|まよ}っている→迷う：02426_mayou⟧。
examples.english: I'm wondering whether to replace my car with a new one.

notes:
{買|か}い{替|か}える is a compound verb: ⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to buy) + ⟦{替|か}える→替える：13399_kaeru⟧ (to replace/exchange).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{買|か}い{替|か}える (to get a new car)
- ⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{買|か}い{替|か}える (to replace one's computer)
- ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{買|か}い{替|か}える (to get a new phone)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {買|か}い{換|か}える: same meaning, sometimes written with this kanji
- ⟦{取|と}り{替|か}える→取り替える：01252_torikaeru⟧: to exchange/replace (not specifically by buying)
- ⟦{新調|しんちょう}→新調：13046_shinchou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have something made new (more formal)
